name: Specificity, Inc.
summary: Specificity, Inc. functions as a comprehensive digital marketing agency. Its core offerings encompass sophisticated targeting methods, including geo-location, search-based parameters, domain-specific strategies, and engagement with pre-qualified audience segments, alongside precise device ID extraction and programmatic display advertising. The firm delivers a broad spectrum of marketing initiatives, spanning email, automated campaigns, retargeting efforts, content creation, digital production, proximity-based promotions, print advertisements, and voice marketing solutions. Furthermore, Specificity handles extensive creative development, crafting social media content, designing websites and brochures, producing radio commercials, establishing brand standards and logos, and authoring blog posts. Their advertising expertise extends to managing campaigns across Google and Bing display networks, Google Local Service Ads, and optimizing pay-per-click (PPC) strategies for both platforms, complemented by targeted print and SMS/text message campaigns. Finally, they provide search engine optimization (SEO) services and facilitate influencer marketing collaborations. Established in 2020, the company maintains its operational headquarters in Largo, Florida.
